name: Band Ankle Eversion

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Physical Therapy Ankle Protocol

steps: Sit on the floor with both legs extended straight in front of you.
Loop a resistance band around the outside of your target foot and secure the other end around your opposite foot.
Start with your target foot relaxed in a neutral position with tension on the band.
Rotate your target foot outward away from your other leg, lifting the outer edge of your foot against the band.
Pause for one count at peak outward turn, then slowly lower back to the center.
coaching_cues: Keep your knee pointing straight up toward the ceiling without letting your whole leg roll outward.
Focus on the peroneal muscles along the outer side of your lower leg.
Control the return so the band does not snap your foot inward.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Physical Therapy Exercise Protocol
